definitions.gloss: the next world, the afterlife, the other side
definitions.explanation: Refers to the world after death in Japanese spiritual and religious belief. Contrasted with この{世|よ} (this world).

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あの{世|よ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見守|みまも}っている→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother is watching over us from the other side.

examples.japanese: あの{世|よ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: Even if I go to the afterlife, I won't forget you.

notes:
あの{世|よ} literally means "that world" and refers to the world after death. It is not tied to a specific religion — it reflects a general Japanese cultural concept of an afterlife.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- あの{世|よ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to pass away (euphemistic)
- あの{世|よ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧: to meet in the afterlife
- あの{世|よ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見守|みまも}る→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧: to watch over from the other side
- あの{世|よ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧: to take with one to the grave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦この{世|よ}→この世：10334_konoyo⟧: this world, the present life
- あの{世|よ}: the next world, the afterlife

USAGE:
Used in both solemn and casual contexts. Can appear in heartfelt expressions about deceased loved ones or in lighthearted exaggerations like あの{世|よ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (I won't forget even in the afterlife).
